user.title: Connect your household
user.description: Sign in with a CoffeyTableRecipes household owner or administrator account. Your password is used once and never saved. Google-only accounts must first add an email/password sign-in method to their existing account.

household.title: Choose your household
household.description: Everyone in this household shares this connection and shopping list.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed. Check your email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to CoffeyTableRecipes. Try again shortly.
error.no_household: This account must be an owner or administrator of a household. Set up your household in CoffeyTableRecipes first. When reconnecting, use an administrator of the original household.

abort.sign_in_again: Authorization expired or was denied. Start setup again.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to CoffeyTableRecipes. Please start setup again shortly.

init.title: Shopping list settings
init.description: Check CTR every 5–300 seconds. Optionally select a Google Keep Sync to-do list to synchronize additions, renames, checkmarks and deletions in both directions. Google authentication stays in Google Keep Sync. Keep is checked every 60 seconds and immediately for CTR requests and HA edits. Clear the selection to stop synchronization.

error.invalid_keep_list: Choose an enabled Google Keep Sync list that is not already connected to another household. Check that the list is selected in Google Keep Sync.
